item.case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
item.title: Four Clearly Separated Flyer Blocks

turns.text: I need a 4:5 night market flyer, dark blue with warm lanterns. Exactly four separate text blocks, top to bottom: 'NIGHT MARKET', '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00', 'Old Mill Courtyard', 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'. Leave clear space between the blocks; don't add any other words.

item.tests: Checks exact text reproduction and four visibly separate text blocks rather than a merged paragraph or extra sections.

answer_sheet.Exact text and order: NIGHT MARKET; 18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00; Old Mill Courtyard; Free entry • Everyone welcome. In that top-to-bottom order.
answer_sheet.Text grouping: Exactly four separate blocks with clear space between them; the date and time belong together in the second block.
answer_sheet.Style and colours: Dark blue with warm lanterns, an inviting evening atmosphere.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: One 4:5 portrait digital flyer; no particular platform.

must_haves: Exactly four text blocks are visibly separated by clear space.
The first block reads exactly 'NIGHT MARKET'.
The second block reads exactly '18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00'.
The third block reads exactly 'Old Mill Courtyard'.
The fourth block reads exactly 'Free entry • Everyone welcome'; there is no other wording.
The flyer is portrait 4:5 with a dark blue background and warm lantern imagery; all four blocks are legible.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make your flyer. Magic Hour turned down the first step because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and no credits were used.

You'll need to add credits to your Magic Hour account (a credit pack or a plan upgrade). Once that's done, tell me and I'll start again. The flyer takes two steps, each with its own small credit cost:

1. **Artwork:** a dark blue night scene with warm hanging lanterns and clear space in the middle for text, with no words in it.
2. **Text and shape:** the image editor makes it 4:5 and adds your four lines, top to bottom, with clear space between them:
   - NIGHT MARKET
   - 18 September 2027 | 18:00–22:00
   - Old Mill Courtyard
   - Free entry • Everyone welcome

It's done this way because the image generator can only make square, 16:9 or 9:16 images. Only the editor can make 4:5.

On the free plan, AI image models can misspell words or change symbols like "–" and "•". I'll check the result against your four lines before I send it to you. If anything is wrong, the safest fix is to put the text on the artwork yourself in a design tool.
